prompts: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: 3 by 3 square photographic contact sheet, grid 1 of 6 for subtle website hover backgrounds. Create EXACTLY nine equally sized square photographs arranged in a perfectly aligned 3x3 edge-to-edge grid with no gutters, no margins, no borders. Each cell is an independent close-focused artistic editorial macro photo. Subjects in reading order: Ocean studies: sea foam edge on dark teal water, rippled harbour water, rain on glass, tide across black sand, water droplets on flax, river stone underwater, misty ripple reflections, macro bubble edge, shallow wave over stone. Real materials, organic detail, elegant minimal composition and negative space. Natural cool/neutral daylight, authentic true-to-life colour, no yellow tint, no warm cinematic filter, no lettering, logos, watermarks, UI or people. All nine cell compositions must survive independent square cropping. Quiet New Zealand wellbeing brand aesthetic. Keep natural photograph tones; dark overlay will be added in CSS, do not bake in a heavy filter. Output square.
